info.title: reqjet
info.description: Runs .http files, runbooks and scripts from the command line (for CI), the same way the Reqjet app does.

options.name: --name
options.description: the request's # @name or title (not needed when the file has one request)

options.name: --requests
options.description: how many to send (default 100)

options.name: --concurrency
options.description: how many at once (default 10)

options.name: --duration
options.description: keep sending for this long instead, e.g. 30s or 2m

options.name: --max-p95
options.description: fail when 95% of requests aren't faster than this, e.g. 500 or 500ms

options.name: --max-error-rate
options.description: fail when more than this percentage of requests fail, e.g. 1

options.name: --k6
options.description:
don't run it: write the same test (settings and thresholds) as a k6 script,
or - to print it

options.name: --env
options.description: environment from http-client.env.json (and .user)

options.name: --var
options.description:
a value for {{name}}, over everything else (repeatable); also answers
runbook inputs and script input()

options.name: --yes
options.description: answer yes to confirmations (otherwise asked, or declined when not interactive)

options.name: --junit
options.description: also write the results as JUnit XML (for CI test reports)

options.name: --summary
options.description:
also append the results as Markdown: --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" puts a
table on the GitHub Actions run page

options.name: --data
options.description:
run each .http file once per row of a CSV or JSON file, with the row's
values as {{variables}} (a file's own # @reqjet.data is used otherwise)

options.name: --update-snapshots
options.description:
save responses as the new snapshots (# @reqjet.snapshot) instead of comparing;
without it a missing snapshot fails

options.name: --root
options.description: where to stop looking for env files (default: the git repository)

options.name: --proxy
options.description:
send through this proxy (http://user:pass@host:port), or "none"; default: the
system proxy (HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY/NO_PROXY, else the OS settings)

options.name: --proxy-bypass
options.description: hosts that skip --proxy: "*.corp.local,10.*" (local addresses always do)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: show URLs, and the response of each failure

options.name: --help
options.description: show this help

options.name: --version
options.description:
show the version
Exit code: 0 when everything passed, 1 when something failed, 2 for a usage error.

commands.name: folder
commands.description: every request in its .http files (and below), in tree order

commands.name: workspace
commands.description: each of its folders in turn, as above (a .reqjet-workspace file saved by the app);
